WildSpark 2.2.3 adds RareScanner 12.1.5.6's 75-entry respawn reference table to WildInfo. Matching NPC tooltips can now show exact intervals, ranges, or event-triggered spawn notes without first collecting a local sample. Imported timings are marked as reference data and are not verified for WoW Forever. Locally learned estimates remain the fallback for NPCs absent from the table.
